name: collections-workspace
description: Collections Workspace: a model-driven app over Business Central virtual tables, bridged to Microsoft 365 Copilot via Xrm.Copilot, a declarative agent and an MCP Apps server.

scripts.build: npm run build -w mcp-server && npm run build -w mock && npm run build -w pcf/CollectionsBridge
scripts.demo: npm run build:widgets && npm run dev -w mock
scripts.demo:http: npm run build:widgets && concurrently -k -n mcp,host "npm run dev -w mcp-server" "npm run dev -w mock"
scripts.ci: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
